E. Gameplay — test anti-air, close hit, standing block, crouch duck, far whiff, landing punishment, and mirrored facing. No invulnerable reversal is implied.
F. Scope — Celestial Palm passed; Heaven Splitter awaits review. Forward L/M/H, Turn/Facing, and Pushbox remain starred; nothing is production-promoted.
